Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Eastport Industrial 7-Drawer Wood Dresser, 49.2"W, Oak Finish
Colors: Brown
Materials: Wood
This simply-designed solid pine dresser finished with an oak veneer will be a perfect addition to your master suite or any bedroom. You'll enjoy modern industrial design with plenty of storage space in seven drawers. Durable solid wood is built to last and sustainably sourced. 49.2"W x 17.7"D x 32.8"H Handcrafted from solid wood. Modern industrial design of natural pine to blend with modern and rustic styles Drawers feature wood runners and metal pulls. No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
